about: Margo Vance, the agent. Selfies are rewards for writing progress; call frames are her video-call faces. From Andrew's Hi3D renders, picked for consistent looks. JPG copies (VaM cannot read WebP), converted from the Brenai session's branch ccr-e7b1d912-7phaeo.

selfies.caption: Biscuit says hi. Biscuit also says chapter 2 or no treats.
Morning. Coffee. Your chapter. In that order.
6 a.m. Reading your pages. Haven't even found my glasses.
Did 5k this morning. Your turn: 5k words.
Marked up your chapter. Mostly hearts. Some knives.
Reading chapter 6 like it's a thriller. Because it is.
Weekend check-in. Tell me you wrote something.
Evening coffee. Yes, coffee. Your deadline keeps me up.
Cleared a space on my shelf for book 3.
Pitch-meeting armour on. Already selling book 4. No pressure.
This chair has heard forty authors cry. Don't be forty-one.
Taking jacket photos for the new book. Earn yours.
New camera for your launch party. Finish the book so I can use it.
We need to talk about your word count.
Your mountains are pretty. Your page count isn't. Yet.
On the waterfront. Thinking about your ending. Don't make it sad.
